execution_assumptions: All jobs must receive one of two placements; any minimum-cost assignment is acceptable but the API returns only the exact cost.
Input validation and report formatting are required surrounding behavior.
No approximate output permission or physical performance target has been approved.
input_domain: jobs have a string name and integer left_cost/right_cost fields; links are valid job index pairs with nonnegative same-side penalties. Non-string names, out-of-range link indices and negative penalties raise ValueError.
software_contract: Return the minimum binary placement cost and a classical metadata report for a job batch.
title: Placement report
